steps.done_when: The tomato is wet and clean, held or resting by the sink with water droplets visible on its skin

steps.do: Dry the tomato with a towel
steps.done_when: The tomato rests on the towel on the cutting board with no visible water droplets on its skin

steps.do: Remove the stem from the tomato
steps.done_when: The tomato on the cutting board has no stem, and the removed stem lies separately on the board

steps.do: Slice the tomato into {slice_count} slices on the cutting board
steps.done_when: The tomato is fully cut into separate slices lying on the cutting board, with no uncut tomato remaining

steps.do: Arrange the tomato slices on a plate
steps.done_when: All tomato slices lie arranged on the plate and the cutting board is empty

steps.do: Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese over the tomato slices
steps.done_when: Shredded mozzarella cheese visibly covers the top of the tomato slices on the plate

steps.do: Sprinkle salt over the tomato slices using a measuring spoon
steps.done_when: Fine white salt grains are visible scattered over the cheese-topped tomato slices on the plate

steps.do: Sprinkle seasoning over the tomato slices
steps.done_when: Dark seasoning specks are visible distributed over the tomato slices on the plate

steps.do: Pour oil over the tomato slices using a measuring spoon
steps.done_when: The tomato slices on the plate have a visible glossy coating of oil on their surfaces

steps.do: Place the plate of prepared tomato slices on the stovetop
steps.done_when: The plate of cheese-topped, seasoned tomato slices rests on the stovetop
